preconditions.description: The input text must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(char.isdigit() == False for char in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must not contain any numeric characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(char for char in text if not char.isdigit())
postconditions.description: The output string is obtained by removing all numeric characters from the input text while preserving all other characters.
